cc:Work.dc:title: Hypothetical conditional row-to-clone CDF envelopes
cc:Work.dc:description: Original mathematical illustration, no empirical data. Pointwise envelopes for multiplicity caps K=1,2,3. The K=3 source application is conditional on the stated assumption contract.
